subject: We couldn't process your payment for Audible
body:
Hi,

We were unable to charge your payment method $14.95 (USD) for your Audible membership. Please update your payment details to avoid losing access.

We'll try again in 3 days.

- The Audible Team
_note: Exploratory case: this is a failed charge attempt, not a confirmed one, and doesn't map to any of the 5 signal types — there's a known, documented gap: no payment_failed signal type exists. Chose relevant:false since forcing this into 'renewal' would misrepresent an unsuccessful charge as a completed one. If a payment_failed type existed, amountMinor ($14.95) and vendorName (Audible) would still be extractable, but billingDate should stay null regardless since 'we'll try again in 3 days' is only a relative reference with no absolute retry date given anywhere in the email.
